product_summary: KTT Pharmatech (division of KanTaaiTi Group), Plot No.17, Manish Ind. Est. No.4, Navghar Road, Vasai (E) 401201, Maharashtra. Real product line per own website (kttpharmatech.com, pages /company/ and homepage): tablet compression tooling — punches and dies (punch-and-die technology), tableting segments/turret segments, compression machine spare parts and change parts, tooling trolleys/transfer trolleys, storage cabinets for tooling, polishing kits, inspection kits, patented 'Swift Clean' auto-tool cleaner, auto-tool shinner, finishline coatings, Spartan steel, tool-care system, machine consultancy/maintenance services. Industries served: pharmaceutical, FMCG, veterinary, confectionery, atomic & research. This is metal-working / precision engineering (tooling), NOT IT or electronics.
role_hint: manufacturer (own manufacturing plant ~10,000 sq ft, 25+ yrs; site self-describes as 'manufacturer and exporter' — export claim not corroborated by any customs line, so 'заявлено, не подтверждено')
comment: HS 902490 ('parts and accessories of instruments/appliances for physical or chemical analysis, measuring or checking') is WRONG for this product line. Tablet punches and dies are interchangeable tools of base metal for pressing/compacting — correct HS-6 is 8207.30 (tools for pressing, stamping or punching); punches/dies specifically are commonly entered under 8207.30. Other lines: 8207.20 (dies for drawing/extruding metal — only if wire-drawing dies, not applicable here), 8480.49 (moulds for mineral products/tablets — only if tablet compression moulds are supplied), 7326.90 (other steel articles — cabinets, trolleys if steel), 8205.59 / 8205.90 (hand tools/kits), 8466.93 (parts of machine tools), 3926.90 (plastic accessories, if any). Industry misclassification: declared 'IT и электроника' contradicts the actual metal tooling/precision-engineering profile — should be pharma machinery / metalworking. Trader signs: none found; site presents own plant and manufacturing, so manufacturer role is plausible, but no independent corroboration of production or of any export shipment — 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to 820730 (primary), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No customs line was available to me in this task, so no product is confirmed by shipment record; all product claims rest on the company website only. PAN AAMFK0185A and revenue not verified here (out of scope of this role).
